# 1 Setup

## 1.1 Reset workspace and set defaults

```{r reset, include=FALSE}
# Clear all plots and variables from workspace
graphics.off()
rm(list=ls(all.names=TRUE))

# Set numerical precision and color schemes
options(digits = 3)
options(ggplot2.discrete.colour= c("#615F63","#FF7F6F","#2F7FC1","#FFBE7A"))
options(ggplot2.discrete.fill= c("#615F63","#FF7F6F","#2F7FC1","#FFBE7A"))
```

## 1.2 Load packages and helper functions

```{r}
# Install and load required packages
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

# CRAN packages for data analysis and visualization
pacman::p_load(
  char = c("tidyverse", "brms", "ggpubr")
)

# GitHub packages for specialized functions
pacman::p_load_gh(char = c("chenyu-psy/smartr@v0.3.2"))

# Source helper functions for readable labels and plot layouts
source("./helpers/label_helpers.R")
source("./helpers/plot_helpers.R")

# Set default ggplot theme
theme_set(theme_analysis())
```

## 1.3 Define output paths and plotting settings

```{r}
task <- "cross_experiment"
model_path <- str_glue("./results/models/models_{task}/")
figure_path <- str_glue("./results/figures/figures_{task}/")

# Create output directories if they do not exist
dir.create(model_path, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_path, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Set cognitive-load prediction styles
pred_line_color <- "grey30"
pred_ribbon_fill <- "grey60"

label_cl_group <- function(exp) {
  exp3_group <- case_when(
    exp == "Exp3_noDist" ~ "noDist",
    exp == "Exp3_Dist" ~ "Dist",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  case_when(
    !is.na(exp3_group) ~ as.character(label_exp3_group(exp3_group)),
    TRUE ~ "none"
  )
}
```

# 2 Memory performance

## 2.1 Load processed memory data

```{r}
Raw_memory_Exp1 <- read_rds("./data/processed/Data_Exp1_Ret.rds")
Raw_memory_Exp2 <- read_rds("./data/processed/Data_Exp2_Ret.rds")
Raw_memory_Exp3 <- read_rds("./data/processed/Data_Exp3_Ret.rds")
```

## 2.2 Summarize observed memory accuracy

```{r}
# Experiment 1
Data_memory_Exp1 <- Raw_memory_Exp1 %>%
  agg_plot(y = Correct, within = c(condition), group = participant)

# Experiment 2
Data_memory_Exp2 <- Raw_memory_Exp2 %>%
  agg_plot(y = Correct, within = c(condition), group = participant)

# Experiment 3
Data_memory_Exp3 <- Raw_memory_Exp3 %>%
  agg_plot(
    y = Correct,
    between = group,
    within = c(condition),
    group = participant
  )
```

## 2.3 Visualize memory performance

### 2.3.1 Experiment 1

```{r}
Plot_memory_Exp1 <- Data_memory_Exp1 %>%
  mutate(
    group = "none",
    condition = label_condition(condition)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean, color = condition)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci),
    linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.05
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(~ group) +
  labs(
    title = "Experiment 1",
    tag = "a",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion Correct"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#615F63", "#FF7F6F", "#2F7FC1", "#FFBE7A")) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#bababa")
  )
```

### 2.3.2 Experiment 2

```{r}
Plot_memory_Exp2 <- Data_memory_Exp2 %>%
  mutate(
    group = "none",
    condition = label_condition(condition)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean, color = condition)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci),
    linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.05
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(~ group) +
  labs(
    title = "Experiment 2",
    tag = "b",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion Correct"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FF7F6F", "#21597B", "#FFBE7A")) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#bababa")
  )
```

### 2.3.3 Experiment 3

```{r}
Plot_memory_Exp3 <- Data_memory_Exp3 %>%
  mutate(
    group = label_exp3_group(group),
    condition = label_condition(condition)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean, color = condition)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci),
    linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.05
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Experiment 3",
    tag = "c",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion Correct",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FF7F6F", "#2F7FC1", "#21597B", "#FFBE7A", "#FF7F00"))
```

### 2.3.4 Combine and save plots

```{r}
Plot_memory_performance <- ggarrange(
  Plot_memory_Exp1, Plot_memory_Exp2, Plot_memory_Exp3,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right",
  legend.grob = get_legend(Plot_memory_Exp3),
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 1,
  widths = c(1.3, 1.3, 2.3)
)

ggsave(
  path = figure_path,
  filename = "Plot_memory_performance.png",
  plot = Plot_memory_performance,
  width = 13,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

# 3 Cognitive load

## 3.1 Load processed cognitive-load data

```{r}
Raw_load_Exp1 <- read_rds("./data/processed/Data_Exp1_load.rds")
Raw_load_Exp2 <- read_rds("./data/processed/Data_Exp2_load.rds")
Raw_load_Exp3 <- read_rds("./data/processed/Data_Exp3_load.rds")
```

## 3.2 Summarize observed data

```{r}
# Experiment 1
Data_Load_Exp1_acc <- Raw_load_Exp1 %>%
  agg_plot(y = acc, within = c(condition), group = participant) %>%
  select(condition, mean, ci) %>%
  rename(acc = mean, acc_ci = ci)

Data_Load_Exp1_load <- Raw_load_Exp1 %>%
  agg_plot(y = load, within = c(condition), group = participant) %>%
  select(condition, mean, ci) %>%
  rename(load = mean, load_ci = ci)

Data_Load_Exp1 <- left_join(Data_Load_Exp1_acc, Data_Load_Exp1_load)

# Experiment 2
Data_Load_Exp2_acc <- Raw_load_Exp2 %>%
  agg_plot(y = acc, within = c(condition), group = participant) %>%
  select(condition, mean, ci) %>%
  rename(acc = mean, acc_ci = ci)

Data_Load_Exp2_load <- Raw_load_Exp2 %>%
  agg_plot(y = load, within = c(condition), group = participant) %>%
  select(condition, mean, ci) %>%
  rename(load = mean, load_ci = ci)

Data_Load_Exp2 <- left_join(Data_Load_Exp2_acc, Data_Load_Exp2_load)

# Experiment 3
Data_Load_Exp3_acc <- Raw_load_Exp3 %>%
  agg_plot(
    y = acc,
    between = group,
    within = c(condition),
    group = participant
  ) %>%
  select(group, condition, mean, ci) %>%
  rename(acc = mean, acc_ci = ci)

Data_Load_Exp3_load <- Raw_load_Exp3 %>%
  agg_plot(
    y = load,
    between = group,
    within = c(condition),
    group = participant
  ) %>%
  select(group, condition, mean, ci) %>%
  rename(load = mean, load_ci = ci)

Data_Load_Exp3 <- left_join(Data_Load_Exp3_acc, Data_Load_Exp3_load)
```

## 3.3 Prepare model data

```{r}
mData_Load <- bind_rows(
  Raw_load_Exp1 %>%
    mutate(exp = "Exp1", participant = factor(participant + 100)),
  Raw_load_Exp2 %>%
    mutate(exp = "Exp2", participant = factor(participant + 200)),
  Raw_load_Exp3 %>%
    mutate(
      exp = ifelse(group == "noDist", "Exp3_noDist", "Exp3_Dist"),
      participant = factor(participant + 300)
    )
) %>%
  select(-condition, -group) %>%
  mutate(exp = factor(exp))
```

## 3.4 Fit cognitive-load model

```{r}
model_linear <- brm(
  formula = correct | trials(nRet) ~ 0 + exp + exp:load + (1 | gr(participant, by = exp)),
  data = mData_Load,
  family = binomial(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 0.75), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 2), class = "sd", lb = 0)
  ),
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 2500,
  chains = 8,
  cores = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
  file = str_glue("{model_path}model_CL_linear")
)
```

## 3.5 Extract predictions and coefficients

```{r}
results_linear <- conditional_effects(
  model_linear,
  effects = "load:exp",
  re_formula = NA,
  prob = 0.95
)

Pred_CL_linear <- results_linear[["load:exp"]] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    group = label_cl_group(exp),
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(as.character(label_exp3_group(c("noDist", "Dist"))), "none")
    )
  )

Beta_CL_linear <- fixef(model_linear) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, ":load$")) %>%
  transmute(
    exp = term %>%
      str_remove("^exp") %>%
      str_remove(":load$"),
    group = label_cl_group(exp),
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(as.character(label_exp3_group(c("noDist", "Dist"))), "none")
    ),
    beta_estimate = Estimate,
    beta = scales::number(Estimate, accuracy = 0.01, style_negative = "minus"),
    beta_label = as.character(str_glue("β = {beta}"))
  )
```

## 3.6 Visualize cognitive-load results

### 3.6.1 Experiment 1

```{r}
Plot_CL_Exp1 <- Data_Load_Exp1 %>%
  mutate(
    group = "none",
    condition = label_condition(condition)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = load, y = acc, group = 1, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = Pred_CL_linear %>% filter(exp == "Exp1"),
    aes(x = load, ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = pred_ribbon_fill,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = Pred_CL_linear %>% filter(exp == "Exp1"),
    aes(x = load, y = estimate__),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = pred_line_color,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = Beta_CL_linear %>% filter(exp == "Exp1"),
    aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = beta_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5,
    color = pred_line_color,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = acc - acc_ci, ymax = acc + acc_ci),
    linewidth = 0.8, width = 0
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = load - load_ci, xmax = load + load_ci),
    linewidth = 0.8, orientation = "y", width = 0
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(~ group) +
  labs(
    title = "Experiment 1",
    tag = "a",
    x = "Cognitive Load",
    y = "Proportion Correct",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, 0.8), xlim = c(0.25, 0.65)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FF7F6F", "#2F7FC1", "#FFBE7A")) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#bababa")
  )
```
